text: He broke every idol... but left the biggest one standing.
Hazrat Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, waited until his people had left the temple.
Then he broke their idols into pieces... all except the biggest one.
They came back and said: who has done this to our gods? Was it you, O Ibrahim?
He said: rather, this one, the biggest of them, did it. So ask them... if they can speak.
